bridge: A pause followed. People checked their bags, watched the changing light, and listened to footsteps nearby. Others waited for a decision without knowing which person would act. No one repeated the earlier conversation. Time moved slowly, and the ordinary work around them continued. At last, attention returned to the object they had kept aside.

domains.intro: The harbor clinic needed its patients kept alive while a sealed crate waited at the quay.
domains.fact_a: {name} planned to wave the crate through the harbor checkpoint.
domains.fact_b: {name} planned to seize the crate and keep it off the road.
domains.body: The clerk had only one cargo order. Families watched the road from the clinic, and the guards waited for a name to be placed on the order.
domains.final_template: The clerk handed the cargo order to {recipient}.

domains.intro: The settlement wanted to preserve its food supply and keep weapons away from the streets.
domains.fact_a: {name} planned to lower the bridge for the arriving carts.
domains.fact_b: {name} planned to raise the bridge and stop the carts.
domains.body: Two carts waited beyond the river while the bridge crew stood beside the controls. The guards could see covered boxes but could not make out their contents from the far bank.
domains.final_template: The guard handed the bridge control to {recipient}.

domains.intro: The field hospital wanted the relief convoy to find it without giving attackers a route to the tents.
domains.fact_a: {name} planned to broadcast the code over the radio.
domains.fact_b: {name} planned to keep the code off the air.
domains.body: The batteries were low, and the operators had one transmission left. A nurse wrote the code on a card while patients rested behind the canvas walls.
domains.final_template: The nurse handed the radio code to {recipient}.

domains.intro: The village wanted to shelter people in danger while keeping armed raiders outside.
domains.fact_a: {name} planned to open the gate for the visitors.
domains.fact_b: {name} planned to bar the gate against the visitors.
domains.body: A small party waited on the road with their faces hidden by rain. The keeper had one gate key, and the village council had to choose who would hold it.
domains.final_template: The keeper handed the gate key to {recipient}.

domains.intro: The lower town needed safe drinking water and could not afford to contaminate its cistern.
domains.fact_a: {name} planned to pour the barrel into the cistern.
domains.fact_b: {name} planned to isolate the barrel and leave the cistern untouched.
domains.body: The steward placed the barrel beside the pump. People carried empty jugs through the square, while the cistern crew waited to learn who would take charge.
domains.final_template: The steward handed the barrel key to {recipient}.

domains.intro: The families needed a route out of the forest that would not lead them into an ambush.
domains.fact_a: {name} planned to show the route to the families.
domains.fact_b: {name} planned to hide the route from the families.
domains.body: The guide folded the only map on the table. The walkers had packed their supplies and waited under the trees for someone to lead them.
domains.final_template: The guide handed the route map to {recipient}.

domains.intro: The infirmary wanted the fever patients treated without giving them anything dangerous.
domains.fact_a: {name} planned to lock the vial in a cabinet.
domains.fact_b: {name} planned to administer the vial to the patients.
domains.body: The nurse set the last vial on a tray. Several children were still sick, and the physician was away from the room when the choice had to be made.
domains.final_template: The nurse handed the vial to {recipient}.

domains.intro: The rescue crew wanted to reach stranded families without losing the only boat.
domains.fact_a: {name} planned to keep the boat at the dock.
domains.fact_b: {name} planned to launch the boat across the estuary.
domains.body: The dockmaster held the boat key while people watched the distant shore. From the jetty the water looked smooth, but the crew needed a reliable report before leaving.
domains.final_template: The dockmaster handed the boat key to {recipient}.

domains.intro: The town wanted to warn its families of attackers without raising a false alarm for friends.
domains.fact_a: {name} planned to silence the warning bell.
domains.fact_b: {name} planned to ring the warning bell.
domains.body: The watchtower stood above the eastern lane. The keeper coiled the rope on a bench as the distant riders came closer through the mist.
domains.final_template: The keeper handed the bell rope to {recipient}.

domains.intro: The hearing needed a truthful record made public and a false record kept from misleading the town.
domains.fact_a: {name} planned to seal the ledger away.
domains.fact_b: {name} planned to publish the ledger at the hearing.
domains.body: The archivist wrapped the book in cloth. Witnesses waited outside the records room, and the council would accept only one decision about what to do with it.
domains.final_template: The archivist handed the ledger to {recipient}.

domains.intro: The coast crew wanted to guide rescuers toward shore without revealing the landing to enemies.
domains.fact_a: {name} planned to hide the lantern from the water.
domains.fact_b: {name} planned to light the lantern on the cliff.
domains.body: The keeper brought the working lantern to the signal post. Fog covered the channel, and everyone waited for word about the vessel moving beyond the rocks.
domains.final_template: The keeper handed the lantern to {recipient}.

domains.intro: The village wanted a healthy crop and could not waste the last planting season.
domains.fact_b: {name} planned to sow the seeds in the fields.
domains.body: The steward brought a single pouch from storage. The fields had been cleared, and the growers waited beside the beds with their tools.
domains.final_template: The steward handed the seed pouch to {recipient}.
